usedFor: Liliphant handles customer conversations and produces analyzed meeting summaries, and Zoho CRM holds the leads. A “New Analyzed Meeting Summary” in Liliphant can run “Create a lead” in Zoho CRM.

bestTemplate.name: “New Analyzed Meeting Summary” in Liliphant, then “Create a lead” in Zoho CRM
bestTemplate.why: A finished summary means a conversation worth following up. “Create a lead” lets you pick a layout and an assignment rule, so the lead is routed as it is created.

watchOut: “New Analyzed Meeting Summary” is polling and set for a chosen company, so leads arrive on a schedule and only for that company.
